title: 461 North Monroe Street (House), 461 North Monroe Avenue, Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: This building is in a neighborhood of similar frame structures from the late nineteenth and early twentieth century. It is an excellent example of vernacular architecture from that era.
